pattern.description: A locked-off live-action interview single; the only motion is the speaker's natural head turn and posture shift while delivering the line.
pattern.why_premium: Soft key light, shallow depth of field and a warm out-of-focus set let the founder's own delivery carry the emotional claim ('agents really feel like colleagues') between UI sections.

build_hint.gsap: No graphic animation; place the live footage clip with a hard cut in and out. If a subtle life is wanted: gsap.fromTo('.footage', {scale: 1.0}, {scale: 1.01, duration: 2, ease: 'none'}).
build_hint.remotion: <Sequence> with <OffthreadVideo>; optional scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 48], [1, 1.01]) for a barely-perceptible drift; no springs.

notes: Camera verdict is none: motion is the subject moving inside the frame. b02 is the face (OCR text is noise) and b03 a corner plant region; not listed separately. SFX candidates look like music pulses.
